ITEM 1 | Cluster of golden-brown pan-fried potato-like wedges with crisp browned edges and pale cream interior, roughly 6 pieces stacked on the left side of the plate, each about 3 to 4 cm long, dry surface with slight sheen | 75
ITEM 2 | Thin, elongated strips of reddish-brown cooked meat with darker caramelized edges and glossy, slightly oily surface, several strips about 10 to 12 cm long and 1 cm wide, curled and lying diagonally across the center | 60
ITEM 3 | Cubes of bright red watermelon-like fruit, firm and moist, cut into roughly 2 cm pieces, clustered on the right side of the plate with a total footprint about one-eighth of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Small dark blue berries, glossy and whole, about 1 cm in diameter, arranged in an arc around the fruit cubes and meat, roughly 25 berries | 25
ITEM 5 | Two whole red strawberry-like halves or pieces, bright red with lighter tips, about 2 to 3 cm across, one sitting near the bottom center of the berry arc and one on the right among the cubes | 25
ITEM 6 | Small pale pink fleshy piece, about 1.5 cm, lying at the upper left edge near the potato wedges | 5
